character.locked_description: Aanya is an 8-year-old South Asian girl with a small, slender build and warm brown skin. Her straight black hair is styled in a neat, low plait that rests against her back. She has a round face with dark, observant eyes. She wears a mustard yellow jumper, colour #E0B341, with the sleeves pulled down completely over her hands, paired with fitted grey leggings and simple dark blue slip-on shoes, colour #3B6D8C. Large, sleek noise-reducing headphones rest comfortably around her neck as a permanent part of her outfit. At rest, she stands with a grounded, upright posture, her covered fingers gently turning a smooth grey pebble in her pocket.
